title: Recurring Retro mall dream
content: The entrance looks almost identical to first pic. i keep having this recurring dream about this place but in different themes and plots. and i always go to the arcade and nowhere else. well this last dream i had i went to this arcade, with random friends i didn’t know and even some famous twitch streamers. and there was this asian girl there and half of her face was bruised black. And she claimed to know me from years ago and sat on my lap. I said “do i know you?” to her response, “yes silly remember me from years ago and you changed my contact to “wife” and i sent you some things and you blocked me and stopped talking to me after?” the vibe turned a little sad, so i tried to make it right and talk to her, but she said “follow me, we have to go now” mind you this mall is like a labyrinth maze with multiple stories and random doors that take you to a whole different place. so i follow her into a stairway, as she was running up the stairway i was following until she got to the top and i heard a door close, but when i get to the top it’s a metal fence door with just electrical boxes behind it. and i open the fence door but leads nowhere. i turn around go back down and come back and now the design of the metal fence door changed, but still leads no where. not a trace of this woman anywhere. so i leave and find my way back to my friends at the arcade and said we should get going. so i find the random door that i somehow know leads RIGHT into my basement like some narnia shit. to see my mom decorating my room as it happens to be my birthday. then i wake up. the vibe of the dream was good and almost nostalgic until i started chasing that girl. then it was just confusion.
